purpose: Canonical full-replay test of stationary sequence-state continuity without requiring current-surface confidence.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 19 changed only benchmark risk/prime state continuity; displayed history and moving/camera paths remained conservative.
interpretation: Mode 19 is rejected. Its textureless fallback regressed to essentially mode-17 behavior: weak/perceptual floor 0.102 and moving-flash 0.468. Source inspection shows the fallback is vetoed by max(localMotionGate, hardwareMotionGate), while signed-prime continuity still independently uses the same raw motion evidence. A uniform brightness reversal can therefore classify as hardware motion and erase the exact opposition prime the fallback was meant to preserve. The next test retains mode-18 current-surface continuity and adds a textureless fallback keyed to scene motion plus coherent current/global transport, applying that same continuity to both risk and signed prime.
